author: Monzia Moodie
scope: modules of src/ and scripts/ that name the graph builders' label column (acmg_label) or define a function with a label_col/label_column parameter (labels.discover_label_sites). Out of scope, stated: the tabular fitters' y arrays and the cohort column 'label', whose fold boundary belongs to the leakage-free baseline (stage 1D-2).

scripts/ablate_gnn.py.reason: GNN ablation and timing harness: reads the TRAINING split's labels (meta_train or y_train) to train a GNN for timing; its scores are not model inputs

scripts/audit_npathogenic_leakage.py.reason: measures the n_pathogenic_in_gene leakage from the stored splits; fits no model

scripts/clean_cohort.py.reason: Phase 0 cohort de-leak: detects the label column and resolves duplicate and label-conflict rows at the cohort source, before splits exist

scripts/probe_label_column_terms.py.reason: checks the cohort's label column against the production term sets; fits no model

scripts/probe_patch_6b.py.reason: 500-row plumbing probe that builds gnn_df as the run driver does (gnn_df['acmg_label'] = y_train.values); trains nothing

scripts/run_phase2_eval.py.reason: the run driver writes y_train into gnn_df and hetero_df: the graph builders' label boundary is set HERE, by the caller (training labels only, measured R-1); the builders cannot tell authorized from unauthorized rows

scripts/validate_clinvar_temporal.py.reason: temporal hold-out evaluation: scores predictions against the label of variants evaluated after the training cutoff

src/genomic_variant_classifier/data/spar.reason: the Spark ETL's enrich stage derives acmg_label from pathogenicity terms

src/genomic_variant_classifier/data/spli.reason: split_summary reports per-split label prevalence when given a label column; it changes no split

src/genomic_variant_classifier/informati.reason: this stage's label authority: defines LABEL_COLUMN, the graph builders' label column name

src/genomic_variant_classifier/models/gn.reason: build_pyg_dataset makes every labeled row of the frame it is given a focal sample: it reads whatever labels the caller passes (non-interference fails on raw labels, holds on the authority's masked labels: tests/unit/test_label_authority.py)

src/genomic_variant_classifier/models/he.reason: assemble_node_features_and_focal and build_hetero_focal_graph make every labeled row a focal sample: they read whatever labels the caller passes (non-interference fails on raw labels, holds on the authority's masked labels)
